title: Add representative workload runners and reporting pipeline v11
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: add a new set of representative workload runners and an updated reporting pipeline to address drift in profiling baselines and to unify reporting ingestion for the benchmark lab. This PR adds end-to-end workload runners for conversational, instruction-following, and long-context generation patterns, updates profiling baseline artifacts for Llama2-13B and Mistral-8x7B quantized builds, and introduces a new GitHub Actions pipeline that uploads summarized metrics to the internal metrics-bucket and updates the BigQuery reporting table schema. Changes include runner templates, sample prompts, eval harness integration, CI pipeline steps, and docs. Checklist: 1) Add representative workload runners for convo/instruction/long-context; 2) Produce profiling baselines in standardized JSONL v2 format; 3) Reporting pipeline that aggregates throughput/latency/token-cost and uploads to metrics-bucket; 4) Update benchmark-lab README and runbook; 5) Add CI smoke test for runners. Testing: local docker-compose staging runs with a small sample set, end-to-end GitHub Actions run in this PR showed successful uploads to the test metrics-bucket and BigQuery dry-run. Backwards compatibility: runners keep previous CLI flags; reporting pipeline can be toggled via REPORTING_ENABLED env var. Related: ENG-2157 (benchmarks consolidation), SUP-412 (customer incident investigating latency regressions). Notes: there are non-trivial additions to the metrics schema; ops must run the migration job (scripts/migrations/update_metrics_schema.sql) after deploy.
commits: 3 commits: 1) Add representative workload runners and templates (runner/*), 2) Add profiling baselines and sample artifacts (baselines/llama2-13b, baselines/mistral-8x7b), 3) Add GH Actions reporting pipeline and migration script (ci/reporting-pipeline.yml, scripts/migrations)
files_changed: runner/conversational_runner.py - new: implements streaming + batching modes and KV cache warmup
runner/instruction_runner.py - new: deterministic seeds and scoring hooks for evals
runner/long_context_runner.py - new: token-slicing harness for >32k sequences
baselines/llama2-13b/profile_v2.jsonl - new: profiling artifacts (latency, mem, kv-cache hit rates)
ci/reporting-pipeline.yml - new: GH Actions workflow that aggregates metrics and uploads to metrics-bucket and triggers bq dry-run
scripts/migrations/update_metrics_schema.sql - new: migration to add schema fields (model_variant, quantization_profile)
docs/benchmark-lab/README.md - updated: run instructions and migration notes
review_conversation: Miguel Torres: Can you clarify how the new runners handle KV cache reuse across requests? The implementation looks fine but we should document expected hit rates.
Author (Aisha Patel): The convo runner warms a small prefix cache by default; added comments and a small section to README explaining the hit-rate expectations and opt-out via --no-prefetch.
Samira Khan: CI failed once due to BigQuery auth in the Actions runner; can we fallback to a dry-run mode in PRs from forks?
Author: Added a dry-run flag and updated the workflow to skip actual uploads for forked PRs. Re-ran CI and it passed.
Jonah Reed: Approving after verifying migration SQL and that migration is idempotent.
Miguel Torres: Minor nit on logging format; request addressed in last commit.
QA (internal): Ran benchmark sample 100x and validated that latency regressions are within expected variance for quantized builds.
Maintainer (Samira Khan): Merged via squash after approvals and CI green.
release_notes: - Added representative workload runners for conversational, instruction, and long-context patterns. - Introduced profiling baselines (v2) for Llama2-13B and Mistral-8x7B. - New reporting pipeline (GitHub Actions) to aggregate and upload benchmark metrics to metrics-bucket and BigQuery dry-run. - Migration script to update metrics schema (ops required).
how_to_run: Local quickstart: python runner/conversational_runner.py --model <model-path> --sample-size 50 --batch-size 8; CI smoke: .github/workflows/ci.yml includes a benchmark-smoke job that runs with REPORTING_ENABLED=false; To enable reporting set REPORTING_ENABLED=true and provide METRICS_BUCKET and BQ_CREDENTIALS as secrets.
notes_for_ops: After deployment run scripts/migrations/update_metrics_schema.sql against metrics DB. Ensure service-account used by GH Actions has BigQuery write permissions for dry-run target before enabling full uploads.
performance_summary: Representative runners produce stable throughput measurements; observed median token/s improvement of 4-7% for Llama2-13B on optimized kernel selection compared to previous baseline in internal staging; memory profiling artifacts attached.
